_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED AUTOMATICALLY BY PTERODACTYL PANEL - PTERODACTYL.IO
name: Minecraft Discord Panel
author: admin@example.com
description: Paper Minecraft server (Java + optional Bedrock via Geyser) run by the Discord panel bot: Discord start/stop panel, DiscordSRV cross-chat, console channel, auto-shutdown and auto-start on join. Everything is configured from the Startup tab.
startup: export PYTHONUSERBASE=/home/container/.local PATH=/home/container/.local/bin:$PATH; if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ] && [ -d .git ]; then git pull --ff-only || true; fi; pip install -q --user --upgrade -r requirements.txt; python -m panel

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
apk add --no-cache git >/dev/null 2>&1
mkdir -p /mnt/server && cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -d .git ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${REPO_BRANCH}" "${REPO_URL}" /tmp/src && cp -a /tmp/src/. /mnt/server/
fi
echo "-----------------------------------------------"
echo "Installed. Fill in the Startup variables (Discord token, role and channel IDs, EULA), then start the server."
echo "The first start downloads Java, Paper and the plugins by itself."

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Message Content + Server Members intents enabled).

variables.name: OP role ID
variables.description: Discord role that may stop/restart the server and use the commands.

variables.name: Console channel ID
variables.description: Live server console (OP role can type commands).

variables.name: Configure channel ID
variables.description: Where the slash commands may be used.

variables.name: Accept Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Set to true to accept https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA

variables.name: Minecraft version
variables.description: Paper version, or 'latest' (resolved once). Raising it later backs up the world and upgrades; it never downgrades by itself.

variables.name: Plugins
variables.description: 'recommended' (Geyser, Floodgate, ViaVersion, ViaBackwards, ViaRewind, SkinsRestorer, spark), 'none', or a comma list of Modrinth slugs. DiscordSRV is always installed.

variables.name: Server name (MOTD)
variables.description: Shown in the server list. &a = colours, \n = second line.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: Leave empty to keep the current value.

variables.name: Auto-shutdown minutes
variables.description: Stop Minecraft after this many minutes with NO players (0 = off). Only stops when the server confirms zero players.

variables.name: Auto-start on join
variables.description: Start Minecraft when someone tries to join while it is offline (Java + Bedrock). Needs the port free while offline, so leave it false if you start Minecraft some other way.

variables.name: Slash commands
variables.description: full = everything, minimal = help/server/players/autoshut/autostart, off = none. The panel, console and cross-chat always work.

variables.name: RAM override (MB)
variables.description: Leave empty: the Java heap is sized from this server's memory limit automatically.

variables.name: Repository URL
variables.description: Git repository with the bot (used by the installer).

variables.name: Auto-update code
variables.description: 1 = git pull the bot code on every start (config, world and plugins are never touched).
